source_title: UP MLC polls: BJP, SP finish with 6-5 scoreline; five key takeaways

Results for all six Teachersâ constituencies and four of five Graduatesâ constituencies had been declared by late Wednesday. The SP candidate had an unassailable lead in the Varanasi Graduates' constituency. The party also retained the Teachers' seat of the district.Of the six Teachersâ seats, BJP won four while the SP secured two. In the Graduatesâ constituencies, BJP has won two seats and the SP three. BJP has retained five out of the six seats it had won in 2020, lost one and gained one seat. SP, on the other hand, retained its tally of three seats of 2020 and gained two new seats.Of the 11 seats, six â Lucknow Graduates', Lucknow Teachers', Meerut Graduates', Meerut Teachers', Agra Graduates' and Bareilly-Moradabad Teachers' â were held by BJP in 2020. This was his fourth consecutive win. Kanti received 56,905 votes, while BJPâs Avnish secured 39,778 votes.
